capabilities: Select the current block excluding its prefix (bullet, heading, quote, checkbox)
Support multiple cursors and optional select-all on repeat
Override list prefixes typed after an existing bullet, number, or checkbox
Suggest custom checkbox and callout types from the active theme
extras: The Select Block feature overrides the default ctrl/cmd A hotkey; the README explains how to disable this and rebind it. Checkbox suggestions are disabled by default.
intentEvidence: This plugin mostly fills feature gaps that I did not find in other plugins.
motivation: The author built it to fill feature gaps they did not find in other plugins.
problem: Obsidian lacks built-in commands for selecting a whole paragraph, bullet, or checkbox as a unit, and themes' custom checkboxes and callouts have no typing suggestions.

relations.evidence: A theme that supports custom checkboxes/callouts, such as AnuPpuccin.

summary: Collection of block editing utilities for selecting blocks without prefixes, overriding list prefixes, and suggesting custom checkboxes and callouts.
